error_model.logging: Does not log; reports conflicts and invalid specs via exceptions.
raises: RuntimeError for conflicting overrides or unsupported TargetSpecKind
RuntimeError if used after cleanup via Cleanable.check_cleaned

side_effects: Resolves target specs against DAG socket refs

runtime_couplings: Uses DagTargetingEngine to resolve TargetSpec to SocketRef matches

dependents.notes: Used by meld resolution to apply spell override maps.

integration_flow: Apply overrides with PATH/UNIQUE/BROADCAST target specs
Use the returned socket map during resolution

order_constraints: Clean DagTargetingEngine before clearing blueprint reference

lifecycle.construction: Validates blueprint and builds a DagTargetingEngine.
lifecycle.ownership: Owns the DagTargetingEngine and holds a blueprint reference.

invariants: Conflicting overrides at the same specificity raise RuntimeError
non_goals: Does not mutate the DAG or blueprint
Does not apply overrides directly to resolution
pitfalls: Expecting non-dict payloads to be accepted
responsibilities: Parse TargetSpec keys and resolve SocketRef matches
Apply specificity precedence to produce a final override map

summary.detail: Builds a socket-aware override map from spell override rules with PATH/UNIQUE/BROADCAST precedence.
summary.one_liner: Resolves spell override rules into SocketRef mappings.

coverage_expectations: Empty or None payload returns an empty map
